config.entityrenderdisabler.title: Entity Render Disabler
config.entityrenderdisabler.enabled.desc: Suppress unchecked entity types and their sounds and effects. Your player and camera remain active. Vehicles carrying visible passengers keep working. Entities still exist on the server.
config.entityrenderdisabler.description: Show this entity and its effects. Uncheck to hide it, mute its sounds and stop its client activity.
